description: Flow playbook (new category): exercises the back-to-back monster-capture path. Pins a regression from playtest 2026-04-13 where two CapturedMonsters sharing (Element, Layer) both produced combatant name 'CapturedMonster-Earth-L5', and CombatSimulationService.Run()'s damageByName.ToDictionary() threw 'An item with the same key has already been added.' The crash bubbled out of MoveCommandHandler.EstimateWinRate and turned every wilderness move into a 'Command failed'. Each cell simulates N encounters with `captureCopies` identical CapturedMonster companions in the party — the exact pathological arrangement that triggered the original bug. The fix adds a '#<index>' disambiguator in BuildEncounter and a defensive GroupBy in Run(). If the fix holds, errorRate is 0 across every cell. NOTE: this playbook uses `kind: flow` because the existing PlaybookEngine evaluates viability-band playbooks (kind: viability, default); a parallel agent is adding the flow evaluator to PlaybookEngine. Until then, the executable regression lives in `CaptureFlowPlaybookTests` under `tools/design/FirstMud.DesignTools.Tests/` and reads this file as data.

metrics.name: successRate
metrics.description: Fraction of attempts where the sim returned a non-Timeout outcome.

metrics.name: fleeRate
metrics.description: Fraction expected to hit the 'sense your power' gate upstream (tracked but not asserted here — MoveCommandHandler enforces the gate before any sim runs).

metrics.name: errorRate
metrics.description: Fraction of attempts that threw. Expected 0 across every cell. Any cell > 0 is a regression.
